text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm eating lunch in the cafeteria,
I catch
sight of Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh... this is nowhere near enough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, stay strong! You must stick to the
plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still being too strict about what
she
eats. I wish I could be of
some help...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Not sure what Miss Prim-and-Proper over
there's tryna prove. I just
know that all she
can think about is wolfing down a bunch of
those cakes she loves.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did'ja hear that? Suppose you would,
bein' right there and all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, yeah! She loves sweets just as
much as I love justice and
liberty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I thought her reign of terror over the
strawberry-flavored realm would
resume
after the tryout race, but I guess not.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speaking of reigns of terror,
it sounds
like the denizens of Planet
Thirteen
require my strength. See ya nara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think she just gave me a valuable hint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I return to my room and spend the rest of
the day researching meal
plans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh... There you are again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: At... your notebook?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll take a look.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A meal plan... There are so many options
that shouldn't cause much
weight gain...
Did you really put this together just for
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And it looks like... I can eat certain
sweets?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Sweets are on the menu?! Are they really
okay to eat?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. To think that you'd
do so much for my sake,
even before
scouting me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I borrowed this
notebook for a while?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh... One more thing. Would you mind
coming to watch me train next
week?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. I look forward to meeting you
then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One week later, I come out to the course
as promised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I hope you've had a productive week,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
I'll begin running. Please watch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I observe her training carefully.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm feeling light as a feather!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each of her strides are powerful and
confident. The difference in her
run is like
night and day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What did you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm honored to hear you say that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can finally exert my full
strength thanks to that meal plan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When it came to my diet, I thought that
trying to eat less was the only
way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your meal plan had more nutritients
despite lower caloric intake,
meaning I
could afford to eat more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think that sweets could even be
factored in... Hehe, I'm feeling so
much
better now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In any case...
I believe I've finally shown
you exactly what I am
capable of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. So allow me to introduce
myself once more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am a member of the Mejiro family. My
name obliges me to run with
the utmost of
grace, splendor, and perfection.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you are to insist on being my trainer,
then you should also be
prepared to call
yourself a Mejiro Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What do you say? Are you prepared to
shoulder the responsibility
that would
entail?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I can certainly hear the confidence
in your voice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Now then, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With your guidance and encouragement,
I'm looking forward to
working together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, my days as Mejiro
McQueen's trainer begin.
